text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While doing my patrol after school, I noticed two
horse girls talking in the corner of the rooftop...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just like you said, I came without telling anyone.
So... what's this important talk about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*... Are you aware of the batting
cage in front of the station?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know it.
I go there pretty often, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then, are you aware that becoming this month's
Home Run King rewards an autographed ball from Yutaka?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's been a huge topic lately.
All the regulars have their sights set on it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, please. Teach me muscle training
that will allow me to hit a home run...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I see... Well, in that case, there's no need for workout.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...? Whatever do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I'm currently the provisional Home Run King!
Once I get the merch, I was planning
on giving it to you anyway, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize, but I cannot accept
the autographed ball from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Eeehh?!
Why not, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Receiving the fruit of someone else's labor without making
an effort myself is out of the question. Unforgivable for a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Victory, glory, autographed balls...
They only hold true value when won by one's own power!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... you're right. It's just as you say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us ensure neither of us has any regrets in this contest.
...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Continuing my patrol after that, this time
I spotted Mejiro McQueen at the gym...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, where should I begin...?
Perhaps dumbbell curls?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you're using dumbbells, I recommend one-arm rows
because they also train your latissimus dorsi.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan... do you intend to advise me?
Do you not wish to protect your Home Run King title?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I have no intention of handing it over.
I'm going to train hard too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I want to compete against you
when you're at your absolute best! So I'm giving full support!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's get into top shape and see who shines
as the Home Run King, McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu... honestly, you never change...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Challenge accepted!
I shall make you regret ever training me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
First up, let's start with 5 sets
of 30 reps of one-arm dumbbell rows!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them sweated it out training
right until the dorm's curfew...!!
